chunks.name: fill_contract
chunks.doc: 🛑️ Fill contract: why a plan stops, the step context a planner transition runs under, the run events and the placed collision entry.

chunks.name: weighted_draw
chunks.doc: 🎲️ Weighted draw: the Fenwick tree over vortex weights and the weighted pick and draw that consume the per-run random stream.

chunks.name: builder_state
chunks.doc: 🏗️ Builder state: the job stages and phases, the fixed owners, the scene and catalog views, the preparation capacity refusal, `FillBuilder` and its retained brush weights.

chunks.name: retirement
chunks.doc: ♻️ Retirement: the incremental release of every owner a `FillBuilder` still holds when it closes, one bounded unit per call.

chunks.name: builder_preparation
chunks.doc: 🧱️ Builder preparation: `begin_preparation`, the close accounting and the cooperative preparation transitions that install the scene, catalogs, meshes, entries, spatial index and lookups.

chunks.name: interactive_fill
chunks.doc: 🧵️ Interactive fill: target and candidate selection, the broad and narrow phase, acceptance, the resets and the planner transition under any step context.

chunks.name: fill_run
chunks.doc: ⏯️ Fill run: the tool run job that steps the planner, publishes every verdict as a trace upsert and keeps accepted placements as provisional ops.

chunks.name: fill_revalidation
chunks.doc: 🔍️ Fill revalidation: the finalize job that re-checks the provisional placements against the committed document and re-appends the survivors.
